description:
Everest Group AI brings Everest Group research and insights directly into ChatGPT, enabling users to access and consume research without leaving their ChatGPT workflow.

Using natural language, users can ask questions about topics important to their work and receive relevant answers grounded in Everest Group content.

For example, users can ask questions such as “What is the market growth in healthcare CXM intelligent operations?” and “What factors are becoming most important in shaping offshore location strategies?” and receive complete responses synthesized through Everest Group's breadth of research.

Access to the agent requires an active Everest Group membership. Users will be prompted to authenticate using their Everest Group website credentials before accessing Everest Group research through the agent. The agent’s responses will include cited content, access to which will depend on the user’s membership. To learn about Everest Group membership, visit www.everestgrp.com/contact-us.

AI Disclaimer: Responses are AI-generated using Everest Group content and may contain inaccuracies. Users should refer to the cited Everest Group research and source materials when additional verification is required. Please report any inappropriate content to privacy@everestgrp.com.
